payload.author: claude
payload.body: Blocked on the keystone: dump.ts/restore.ts are deeply SQLite-bound (store.rawDatabase() DatabaseSync, sqlite_master, PRAGMA table_info, PRAGMA foreign_keys, BEGIN IMMEDIATE) AND take a FrickStore — there's no PG-backed FrickStore to dump/restore against until createFrickServer runs on Postgres. Two prerequisites: (1) the keystone (async FrickStore construction + porting devtools/platform-events off rawDb so the server can run on PG), then (2) rewrite dump/restore to use the async SqlDriver with dialect-agnostic introspection (information_schema vs sqlite_master/PRAGMA) + driver.transaction. Recommend doing the keystone next; FR-25/FR-27/FR-28 all build on it.
